wsrep_cluster_address.description: List of cluster node addresses in 'host:port' format. The arbitrator will connect to these nodes to participate in quorum decisions.

wsrep_node_name.description: Unique name for this arbitrator node — must not conflict with any Galera cluster node name.

log_path.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to syslog/stderr (recommended for systemd environments).

repl_connect_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before giving up on reconnecting to the cluster after disconnection. 0 means infinite retries.

wsrep_ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate file (PEM format) for this arbitrator. Required if using SSL.

wsrep_ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file (PEM format). Required if using SSL.

wsrep_ssl_ca.description: Path to CA certificate file (PEM format) used to verify cluster nodes' certificates. Required if using SSL with CA verification.

use_ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS for communication with cluster nodes. Enable only if Galera cluster uses SSL.

socket_buffer_size.description: Socket send/receive buffer size in bytes. Set >0 only if experiencing high latency or timeouts.

wsrep_cluster_name.description: Name of the Galera cluster. Must match the cluster name used by all Galera nodes.

garbd_join_timeout.description: Seconds the arbitrator waits for initial cluster connection before giving up.

items.description: Additional custom Galera options (e.g., `pc.weight=5` or `evs.suspect_timeout=2s`). Each entry is a key-value pair.

value.description: Option value. Strings should be quoted in config.

extra_galera_options.description: List of custom Galera configuration options to append to the config. Use only if you need advanced tuning.
